basic_info.description: Welcome to 275-279 San Jose Avenue, a classic Victorian 4-unit gem perfectly positioned at the crossroads of Noe Valley and the Inner Mission - two of SF's most sought-after neighborhoods. This rare offering includes two VACANT top-floor units, providing incredible flexibility for owner-occupants and investors alike. Live in one and rent the other at market rate, or occupy both for a spacious 4-bedroom setup. For investors, the opportunity to lease all four units ensures strong income potential with room to grow. The lower-level flats are occupied by long-term, month-to-month tenants (Unit 275: 2BD/1BA, Unit 279: 1BD/1BA), offering immediate income with future upside. A 3-car side-by-side garage, currently vacant and accessible via Poplar Street, adds even more value - ideal for private use or extra rental income. Plus, a huge basement provides ample storage, laundry potential, or even future potential development possibilities. Enjoy unbeatable walkability to local favorites cafes, dining, shopping, parks, BART, tech shuttles, and more. You're minutes from Bernal Heights, Glen Park, Potrero Hill, and all that Noe Valley/Mission has to offer. Whether you're an investor seeking solid returns or a homeowner looking for lifestyle and location, this property is a must-see.
